thread:
incident_bot: Paging: SEV2 — elevated 5xx rate detected at edge gateway (route /v1/generate). Alerting threshold crossed at 16:07 UTC, rolling 5m error rate ~18%. Auto-page to #oncall and SRE rotation.

laura_sre: I'll take it. seeing a big jump in 502/504 from gateway -> envoy upstream timeouts. No obvious host OOMs on GPU fleet.

andy_oncall: oncall here. Confirming impact: customer-facing inference latency spikes, some requests get 5xx. Amanda can you confirm customer tickets?

amanda_support: getting a couple high-priority tickets from enterprise T2 customers reporting timeouts around the same window. Not widespread but hits paying customers and some trial apps. Logging the affected customer IDs privately.

laura_sre: thank you. quick snapshot from edge logs: many requests show upstream reset after retry attempts. Pattern: edge has retries enabled, multiple attempts causing more pressure on upstream which triggers envoy circuit-breaker for pending requests.

priya_eng: that's suspicious — we rolled the edge route weighting and a retry policy change in this morning's rollout (edge-config v2026-03-15-09). Could be correlated. Pulling the rollout diff now.

max_infra: I can pull the config from gitops. small diff: retry on 5xx added with per-try-timeout 1s and attempts 2 for /v1/generate route. Also cluster circuit-breaker for pending_requests is 100.

priya_eng: copying the relevant snippet: ```
route: /v1/generate
  retry_policy:
    retry_on: 5xx,connect,refused_stream
    num_retries: 2
    per_try_timeout: 1s
cluster: llm-upstream
  circuit_breakers:
    thresholds:
      - max_pending_requests: 100
```

laura_sre: Thanks. Hypothesis: the retry policy + low per_try_timeout is triggering rapid retries that amplify load and push upstream into pending queue limit -> envoy returns 5xx. Also some downstream clients hit the gateway which retries, creating a retry storm.

andy_oncall: mitigation plan options: (A) temporarily disable retries at gateway for /v1/generate, (B) increase circuit breaker pending_requests, (C) route traffic away from the problematic upstream pool, (D) roll back this morning's rollout. I propose A + B immediate, then C if no improvement.

tom_reliability: +1 to disabling retries first — that has the fastest flip. Increasing circuit breaker buys breathing room but may hide saturation.

laura_sre: executing CLI to disable retries on the route (patch via control plane): ```bash
curl -X PATCH https://controlplane.internal/api/routes/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN' -d '{"retry_policy": null}'
# apply
```

laura_sre: applied. pushing new config to edge. watching metrics...

priya_eng: also increasing cluster pending_requests to 300 as short-term: ```yaml
cluster: llm-upstream
  circuit_breakers:
    thresholds:
      - max_pending_requests: 300
```
applied via gitops; sync in progress.

laura_sre: within 60s error rate dropped from 18% -> 6%. Latency median improved. Some 5xx still trickling.

andy_oncall: good sign. Amanda, can you tell customers we're mitigating and monitoring?

amanda_support: sending a short status update to impacted customers: "We're aware of increased timeouts and have applied mitigations; we're monitoring and will follow up with root cause." Will mark as incident and escalate to account teams.

max_infra: noticed a small spike in CPU on a subset of the upstream hosts — they were receiving retry traffic back-to-back. Rolling a traffic shift to cluster B (standby pool) for 20% to relieve pressure. Doing gradual shift now.

laura_sre: after traffic shift to cluster B and retry disable + increased pending, errors down to baseline ~0.8%. Looks stable for last 6 minutes.

tom_reliability: recommend we keep retries disabled on gateway for next 2 hours and revert only after canary validation. Also open a rollback PR for the morning rollout if the team prefers.

priya_eng: agreed. I'll open a PR to revert the retry-policy change and include a test harness to simulate heavy concurrent inference to reproduce.

andy_oncall: documenting incident: SEV2, root cause likely interaction of newly deployed retry policy + tight per-try timeouts leading to retry amplification and Envoy circuit-breaker tripping. Mitigations: disabled retries on route, increased pending_requests, shifted traffic to standby cluster. Impact: elevated 5xx for ~18 minutes, affected several enterprise customers; no data loss.

laura_sre: handing off to Tom for follow-up/RCAs and to priya for code/rollout changes. I'll continue to monitor for 30m then clear the page.

tom_reliability: taking over. I'll coordinate a postmortem doc (timeline, diffs, test plan, rollback guidance). Assigning action items: add automated load test for retry policies, add canary gating for route-level retry changes, add alert for retry amplification pattern.

amanda_support: I'll consolidate customer notifications and follow up with account managers.

andy_oncall: thanks team. Closing active page for now but keeping the thread open for updates. :thumbsup:

incident_bot: Incident update: status -> mitigated, severity downgraded to P3. Incident record created: INC-2026-179999. Please add notes for RCA.

laura_sre: marking this thread resolved from SRE side. Will post logs+graphs to the postmortem doc shortly.

priya_eng: PR opened to revert change and add tests: https://git.internal/r/redwood/edge-config/pull/458.

max_infra: leaving temporary circuit-breaker increase in place until PR merges; will scope a gradual rollback during low traffic window.

tom_reliability: next steps captured. Thanks all.
